article.title: Akai is embracing vibe-coded mods with an open-source MPC

harvestedTerms.summary: Akai is releasing an open-source MPC Sample Key hardware synthesizer and embracing community firmware mods created through vibe coding, including custom synths built with Claude. The article describes how hardware manufacturers are beginning to actively court AI-assisted modding communities by providing early access, open-source firmware, and SDKs.

article.title: Microsoft is ending Copilot support on smart TVs

harvestedTerms.summary: Microsoft is ending Copilot support on LG and Samsung smart TVs, discontinuing a feature announced at CES 2025. The article describes Microsoft repositioning Copilot away from a TV-based AI companion toward a business/productivity 'super app.' Thin on lasting conceptual content — primarily a product discontinuation story.

article.title: The October inflection point for vibe game development

harvestedTerms.summary: Simon Willison documents what he considers an October 2026 inflection point in vibe-coded game development, arguing that Claude Opus 5.5 (and to a lesser extent GPT-6 Astra) now exhibits genuine 'game design' capability — producing fun, emotionally resonant games from minimal prompts. The post covers four games built with vibe coding techniques, notes multiplayer and AI-vs-AI features in Battle Drones, and observes that the new constraint is concept novelty rather than technical execution.

mustReadFlagged.reason: A practitioner's honest, specific account of a capability threshold moment — not a product announcement but a working developer's before-and-after evidence that models have crossed into genuine game *design* (not just game *generation*). The 'make it a LOT more fun — and it did' passage is a memorable data point for anyone tracking the jagged frontier of AI creative capability.
